sample.format: Universal Mach-O executable, x86_64 and arm64
sample.signature: Ad-hoc; identifier com.apple.Network; no certificate or signing team

summary: Native anti-analysis loader carrying an authenticated, run-only AppleScript infostealer. It steals browser credentials, cookies and extension stores, wallets, messaging sessions and Keychain material; phishes the login password, uploads collected data, and contains wallet replacement and persistence routines.

provenance.feed_note: AMOS ClickFix Foxveil Mach-O macho macOS
provenance.attribution_limit: AMOS/Foxveil are feed labels. Hostile behavior is independently established; the exact malware family and initial delivery mechanism are not independently proven.

native_execution.evidence: __mod_init_func points to constructor 0x10008dc64. Most earlier code consists of arithmetic/opaque-control-flow distractions. main dispatches into those decoys.

task_info(TASK_DYLD_INFO) obtains the loaded image list. A custom SipHash-2-4 name resolver walks Mach-O export tries, checks terminal flags and adds image bases. Offline hashing of local SDK symbols resolved 38 of 44 hashes. See evidence/resolved-api-hashes.json.

Environment and process checks, sysctl debugger/virtualization checks, exception ports, signing/image checks, API hook checks, a code-section SHA-256 check, and a 50 ms elapsed-time check contribute to decryption-key construction. The timeout selects an XOR-corrupted word before big-endian conversion.
x86_64 API entries are checked for INT3/near JMP. ARM64 pairs are checked for masked BRK instructions and an LDR-literal trampoline (0x58000050); detected hooks clear a cached API pointer.
Helper code is mapped writable, changed executable, and instruction cache invalidated; a JIT fallback changes pthread JIT write protection.

Hash-resolved OpenDefaultComponent, AECreateDesc, OSALoad and OSAExecute process the recovered compiled bytes. FourCC operands sum to osa / scpt / null. A system import alone does not establish the native handoff.

bootstrap.behavior: Sets _p0=772, _p1=897, _p2=310; returns zero. No theft behavior in this bootstrap.

payload.integrity: Every encrypted chunk passed AES-GCM authentication, including discarded chunks. The concatenated retained payload matched its independently stored SHA-256.

authenticated_recovery.recipe: 36-byte password: selected big-endian word followed by the XOR of the measured __TEXT,__text SHA-256 and embedded expected digest. PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 uses 95,614 iterations and a 32-byte salt to derive a 32-byte AES key. Each chunk nonce is derived with HKDF-SHA256. A custom table maps Base64 characters and skips invalid bytes, including inserted NULs.
authenticated_recovery.configuration: Nine configuration values were separately recovered with authenticated AES-GCM. The constructor sets their environment variables before OSA execution and unsets them afterward. See evidence/decoded-config.json.

payload_behaviors.evidence: Decoded calls copy Chromium Login Data, Cookies, Web Data, Local Extension Settings, IndexedDB and Local Storage/leveldb; Firefox login/key databases and profiles; Safari cookie stores. See payload-reduced.applescript lines 516-655 and 842 onward.

payload_behaviors.claim: Login password phishing and Keychain access
payload_behaviors.evidence: A hidden-answer dialog claims System Preferences, validates the answer with dscl . authonly, loops on failure and saves the password. security find-generic-password reads Chrome Safe Storage; the payload also targets login.keychain-db and adjusts its Chrome partition access list. Lines 718-783 and 2465-2518.

Targets include Electrum, Coinomi, Exodus, Atomic, Wasabi, Ledger Live, Monero, Bitcoin, Litecoin, Dash, Electron Cash, Guarda, Dogecoin, Trezor Suite, Sparrow, 1Password data, Discord and Telegram tdata. Decoded target lists and copy calls corroborate the categories.

system_profiler and process-list commands collect host/process context. ditto packages collected material. curl POST requests upload archives to /contact; other routines report stages/status. The decoded strings are supported by exec/copy/archive call structure.

Download/extraction routines target Ledger and Exodus application bundles, use /zxc/app.zip and /zxc/appex.zip, and terminate the corresponding applications. These are conditional routines; static analysis does not prove they ran on any host.

Downloads a helper, checks a size floor, chmods it executable, removes quarantine, ad-hoc signs/verifies it, and invokes it with -harvest -contact -user-enc -buildid-enc under a 1200-second watchdog. Launch daemon/agent creation and user-context switching routines use hidden Apple-like support paths and system-like labels.

configured_network_indicators.status: Recovered configuration only. No contact with these endpoints was made; current reachability and server contents are unknown.

analysis_limits: No native sample, embedded script or extracted helper was executed. Recovery performed data-only decoding and system cryptographic operations.
osadecompile could not recover source from the run-only script. A static third-party bytecode decompiler and cleave/filefacts call/literal facts were used instead.

The static decompiler can misreconstruct high-level variables and control flow. Its local analysis copy records all MessageSend calls as CALL comments to retain discarded expressions. Arithmetic string decoding folds only inspected literal-only helpers; it does not interpret AppleEvents or commands.

The payload contains 59 handlers; filefacts reported an unsupported opcode 0x6e in one helper. Remaining handlers and decoded calls still establish the theft and staging behavior. Six native API hashes remain unresolved.
All capabilities described are static findings. Actual infection, theft, persistence installation and network delivery on a victim host were not observed.

tooling.native: Ghidra headless decompilation, otool/rizin, lipo, codesign inspection
tooling.applescript: cleave/filefacts compiled-script parser plus https://github.com/n0kovo/applescript-decompiler (MIT); local analysis copy adds call comments
tooling.data_recovery: decode_payload.py, decode_config.py, hash_apis.py, reduce_applescript.py; these are specimen analysis helpers, not scanner engine decoders

taxonomy_review.claim: Elapsed-time comparison selects an XOR-mutated, byte-reversed word.
taxonomy_review.placement: Required instruction relationship supports timing-based inspection evasion, rather than a generic clock capability.
taxonomy_review.change: Added one ARM64 scheduling/register variant while retaining all prior patterns, Mach-O/macOS scope, text section and size cap. New pattern fixes instruction constants, not addresses, XOR masks or key bytes.
taxonomy_review.controls: Different mask/register/stack slot positive; ordinary timer and XOR without threshold negatives.

taxonomy_review.claim: Paired API entry checks recognize BRK/literal trampolines and disable a pointer.
taxonomy_review.placement: Instruction integrity/hook rejection is the supported result. ARM64 is implementation scope, not a directory.
taxonomy_review.controls: Paired-check positive with changed displacement; single-check negative.

taxonomy_review.claim: A hashed export-name comparison selects a terminal and reconstructs an image-relative address.
taxonomy_review.placement: Import hiding by API hashing. Moved from the implementation-named native-api-hash directory into the existing mechanism leaf.
taxonomy_review.preservation: Both original x86_64 resolver alternatives, severity and effective scope preserved. Existing exact references and focused fixtures updated. No aliases or duplicate definitions. ARM64 support is separately added and tested.
taxonomy_review.controls: ARM64 full terminal positive, missing terminal-flag operation negative; all nine existing x86_64 mechanism controls pass.

taxonomy_review.claim: Timing-dependent key mutation co-occurs with an encoded blob and paired API integrity checks.
taxonomy_review.placement: The independently required anti-analysis roles justify the timing-evasion result. The description makes no source-to-sink handoff claim.
taxonomy_review.change: Replaced the unsupported shell-payload composite that relied on a system import. Neither an interpreter identity nor a shell execution chain is inferred from that import.

regressions.new_cases: 9/9 passed (seven synthetic controls, native fixture, recovered script)
regressions.fixture_note: Direct scans under testdata suppress the forged Apple identity via an existing test-directory exception, so the native focused case requires two hostile results. Full validation stages files at neutral paths and requires three; native fixture enables inline YARA explicitly.
regressions.shared_tree_validation: Blocked by concurrent unrelated readdir/agent/process-filter authoring errors; preserved without reverting them.
regressions.isolated_validation: PASS: make validate on the clean baseline plus this change. All fixture groups passed; see evidence/validate-isolated.log. The validated rule, reference-control and hostile-fixture files were byte-compared with the final working files.
regressions.directory_budget: API-hashing leaf: 98 direct rule definitions (97 before the move), within the 100-rule budget. No platform/language directories were added.

reproduction.recovery: Copy decode_payload.py, decode_config.py, hash_apis.py, reduce_applescript.py and decompiled/ to a temporary work directory. Extract its arm64.macho using lipo -thin arm64. Run decode_payload.py with Python 3 on macOS; it writes authenticated bootstrap.scpt, payload.scpt, key-recovery.json and chunk manifests. decode_config.py then reads the preserved inspected native decompilation and recovered key. No specimen instructions are executed.
reproduction.bytecode_analysis: To reproduce string folding, copy evidence/payload-decompiled.applescript to that work directory and run reduce_applescript.py. The saved CALL annotations preserve MessageSend expressions discarded by upstream high-level reconstruction.
reproduction.fixture_integrity: The original Mach-O fixture and recovered SCPT are byte-identical to the hashes recorded above; generated control programs are never executed.

validation_provenance.scope: Clean committed baseline plus the three changed/moved rule files, two existing reference-control files, two hostile fixtures and their expectations. Concurrent unrelated edits were excluded from this snapshot only, without changing the working tree.
